description: Phase 0 machine-readable evidence matrix inventorying authoritative linguistic resources, descriptive grammars, existing corpora, NLP datasets, and regional language references.

resources.name: Pramanik Bangla Byakaran (Standard Bangla Grammar, Vols. 1-3)
resources.blf_relevance: Primary national authority for morphological inflection paradigms, verb conjugations, and standard syntax.
resources.potential_use: Authoritative baseline for morphosyntactic rule extraction and canonical BDSB sentence constructions.
resources.known_limitations: Printed multi-volume treatise; copyright prohibits verbatim reproduction; descriptive rather than machine-parseable.
resources.notes: Published by Bangla Academy. Volume 1 covers phonology and orthography; Volume 2 covers morphology and word classes; Volume 3 covers syntax and discourse.

resources.name: Bangla Academy Promito Bangla Bananer Niyom (Standard Bangla Spelling Rules)
resources.blf_relevance: Authoritative standard for Bengali Unicode NFC normalization, vowel harmony orthography, and loanword spelling.
resources.potential_use: Algorithmic implementation of spelling normalization and orthographic disambiguation in blf.linguistics.normalizer.
resources.known_limitations: Covers orthographic rules only; does not provide sentence-level or syntactic data.
resources.notes: Codifies standard modern conventions including the reduction of redundant 'ণ'/'ষ' in non-Tatsama words and elimination of unnecessary hasant.

resources.name: Purbo Pakistaner Ancholik Bhashar Abhidhan / Bangladesher Ancholik Bhashar Abhidhan
resources.language_variety: Regional Varieties (Chattogram, Sylhet, Noakhali, Barishal, Rangpur, Rajshahi, Mymensingh, Dhaka)
resources.blf_relevance: Most exhaustive institutional catalog of regional Bangladesh dialect vocabulary and phonetic variants ever compiled.
resources.potential_use: Ground-truth regional vocabulary and dialect mapping for Sylheti, Chatgaya, Noakhailla, and northern varieties.
resources.known_limitations: Lexicon-level entries with occasional illustrative phrases, but lacks connected dialogue or structured sentence families.
resources.notes: Reissued by Bangla Academy in unified multi-volume format. Indispensable for preventing fabricated dialect vocabulary.

resources.name: Bangla Academy Bengali-English Dictionary (3rd Edition)
resources.blf_relevance: Standard reference for Bangla-English lexical alignment, register distinctions, and idiomatic phrase translations.
resources.potential_use: Lexeme-level translation grounding and semantic role mapping for core vocabulary.
resources.known_limitations: Copyrighted print publication; lacks machine-readable API; modern digital slang and informal Banglish are underrepresented.
resources.notes: Major institutional standard for bilingual equivalence in Bangladesh administrative and academic contexts.

resources.name: The Origin and Development of the Bengali Language (ODBL)
resources.blf_relevance: Foundational scientific treatise on Bangla phonology, nominal declensions, verbal inflections, and dialect groupings.
resources.potential_use: Theoretical grounding for morphological segmentation, case systems, and historical Sadhu vs Cholit mappings.
resources.known_limitations: Pre-1947 scope centered on historical Indo-Aryan evolution; does not reflect modern post-1971 Bangladesh urban colloquial speech.
resources.notes: Seminal baseline for Indo-Aryan linguistics. Public domain in Bangladesh and internationally.

resources.name: Bakkototto (Bangla Syntax)
resources.blf_relevance: First rigorous transformational-generative treatment of modern Bangla clause structure, topicalization, and passivization.
resources.potential_use: Direct formal modeling of grammatical constructions, argument structures, and word-order permutations (SOV, OSV).
resources.known_limitations: Theoretical Chomskyan framework; focus is on syntactic rules rather than corpus statistics.
resources.notes: Crucial bridge between traditional school grammar and modern formal computational syntax.

resources.name: Bengali: A Comprehensive Grammar
resources.blf_relevance: Extensive empirical documentation of spoken colloquial Bangla, compound verbs, reduplication, and pragmatic particles (-to, -i, -o, -na).
resources.potential_use: Designing pragmatic and discourse annotation guidelines for conversational sentence families.
resources.known_limitations: Copyrighted commercial book. Examples reflect both Bangladesh and Kolkata idioms without explicit statistical breakdown.
resources.notes: Highly systematic reference for colloquial sentence construction and pragmatic nuance.

resources.name: Universal Dependencies Bengali Treebank (bn_bengal)
resources.blf_relevance: Open, standardized dependency treebank mapping Bangla syntax to international Universal Dependencies schema.
resources.potential_use: Benchmark evaluation baseline for syntactic dependency parsers and cross-framework syntax mapping.
resources.known_limitations: Relatively small corpus size (1,048 sentences); strictly formal/literary domain; zero representation of Banglish, colloquial dialogue, or dialects.
resources.notes: Tested in BLF v0.1 baseline schema validation.

resources.name: IndicCorp v2 (Bengali Monolingual Corpus)
resources.blf_relevance: Large-scale web crawl corpus useful for statistical token distributions, vocabulary coverage, and pretraining baselines.
resources.potential_use: Lexical frequency validation, character n-gram distribution checks, and vocabulary coverage benchmarks.
resources.known_limitations: Completely unstructured; contains web noise, translationese, OCR artifacts; zero semantic frame, morphological, or pragmatic annotations; lacks Bangladesh colloquial spoken language.
resources.notes: Permissive CC0 license allows open redistribution and statistical extraction.

resources.name: Bengali.AI Multiregional Speech Corpus & Common Voice Bangla
resources.blf_relevance: Authoritative open corpus for Bangladesh spoken phonology, acoustic realization, and regional speaker diversity.
resources.potential_use: ASR/TTS compatibility validation, phonetic realization checks, and spoken sentence extraction.
resources.known_limitations: Primarily prompt-reading rather than spontaneous multi-turn dialogue; text prompts are largely sourced from Wikipedia and newspaper sentences.
resources.notes: Verified CC0 redistribution terms; high-value asset for speech-to-text and phonetic alignment.

resources.name: Banglish-to-Bengali Transliteration & Normalization Dataset
resources.organization: Qatar Computing Research Institute (QCRI) / BRAC University
resources.blf_relevance: Directly addresses the Banglish-to-Bangla transliteration layer, capturing authentic non-standard phonetic spelling variations.
resources.potential_use: Grounding for transliteration_banglish field and script-variation normalization in BLF utterance schemas.
resources.known_limitations: Focus is purely surface transliteration; does not provide syntactic, semantic frame, or morphological annotations.
resources.notes: One of the few peer-reviewed, human-curated datasets for Bangladesh social media Romanized text.

resources.name: SentiraBangla: Multi-Domain Sentiment & Code-Mixed Dataset
resources.blf_relevance: Provides empirical evidence of modern Bangladesh commercial and social media code-switching patterns.
resources.potential_use: Establishing code-switching taxonomy and test fixtures for mixed-script utterances.
resources.known_limitations: CC-BY-NC-4.0 license prevents commercial redistribution; annotations limited to sentiment/domain rather than deep syntax or semantic frames.
resources.notes: Non-commercial license constraint requires feature extraction rather than raw dataset packaging.

resources.name: IndicTrans / Bharat Parallel Corpus (Bangla-English Split)
resources.blf_relevance: Massive parallel translation corpus for evaluating translation quality and sentence-level bitext alignment.
resources.potential_use: Benchmarking baseline machine translation models and extracting parallel English references for standard sentences.
resources.known_limitations: Significant synthetic and back-translated component; noticeable translationese; lack of pragmatic and dialectal nuance.
resources.notes: Useful as an empirical reference for parallel translation statistics, but requires strict filtering before gold extraction.

resources.name: Sylheti Language Corpus & Nagri Script Archive
resources.organization: SOAS University of London / Sylheti Project
resources.blf_relevance: High-fidelity academic recording and transcription of Sylheti dialect phonology, verbal clitics, and case morphology.
resources.potential_use: Ground-truth morphological rules for Sylheti dialect realization variants in BLF sentence families.
resources.known_limitations: Restricted non-commercial research license; specialized archival format requiring custom extraction scripts.
resources.notes: Essential linguistic reference for authentic Sylheti realization without AI-hallucinated spellings.

resources.name: A Linguistic Analysis of Chittagonian (Chatgaya) Phonology & Morphology
resources.organization: University of Chittagong Press / Bangla Academy
resources.blf_relevance: Authoritative linguistic analysis of Chatgaya pitch-accent distinctions, post-verbal negation (*-no* vs *-na*), and unique case markers.
resources.potential_use: Rule extraction for Chatgaya dialect realization variants in BLF ontology.
resources.known_limitations: Printed academic monograph; copyrighted; no machine-readable dataset.
resources.notes: Documents systematic tonal and morphosyntactic divergences between BDSB and Chatgaya.
